domains.name: Emergency Situations
domains.description: In a crisis, clarity saves time; newcomers drill short, strong phrases that work under stress.

packs.title: Calm Under Pressure
packs.description: Handle urgent moments in clear, simple English, from calling 911 to reporting a problem, so stress never becomes a language barrier. A free CanadaReady starter pack.

outcomes.name: Call for Help
outcomes.description: Place urgent calls and give your location clearly.
scenario_ideas: Call 911, state the emergency, and give your address
Report a gas smell and answer dispatcher questions
Ask a neighbour for urgent help using simple words
Leave a clear voicemail for your landlord about a burst pipe

outcomes.name: Handle Everyday Urgencies
outcomes.description: Manage non-911 urgencies quickly and politely.
scenario_ideas: Tell a pharmacist you need urgent non-prescription help
Report a lost wallet and cancel a card by phone
Explain a car problem when calling for a tow
Ask for directions to the nearest emergency room

outcomes.name: Communicate After an Incident
outcomes.description: Describe events accurately once the immediate danger has passed.
scenario_ideas: Give a simple statement to police at the scene
Describe what happened during an insurance claim call
Update family members about a situation calmly
Ask a doctor what happened and what comes next

domains.name: Finance
domains.description: Every dollar matters in a new country; learners master banking, budgets, and everyday money conversations.

packs.title: Money Confidence
packs.description: Open accounts, understand fees, and talk about money without confusion. A free CanadaReady starter pack for everyday banking.

outcomes.name: Bank with Ease
outcomes.description: Complete basic banking tasks independently.
scenario_ideas: Open a bank account and ask about monthly fees
Deposit a cheque at the ATM or with a teller

outcomes.name: Manage Daily Money
outcomes.description: Track, question, and control everyday spending.
scenario_ideas: Ask about exchange rates when sending money home
Dispute a charge you do not recognize on your statement

Buy the right fare card and ask about transfers

Report a missed connection or lost item to transit staff

outcomes.name: Take Taxis and Ride-Shares
outcomes.description: Arrange and complete private trips smoothly.

scenario_ideas: Book an appointment by phone and confirm health card details
Ask a receptionist about walk-in times and waits

scenario_ideas: Ask about side effects before starting a new medication
Confirm follow-up steps at the end of an appointment

outcomes.name: Prendre soin de soi

Demander un deuxième avis poliment

packs.description: Courriels, réunions, jasette du midi et nuances hiérarchiques : gagnez votre place dans une équipe de travail en français québécois.

domains.name: Government Services
